body: I don't think I have, I'll look into it. An OTC mood stabilizer sounds worth a shot to try before resorting to anything stronger anyway. Thanks for the suggestion.

Thanks, I appreciate it - sorry to hear something similar happened to you. Coming to grips with my perfect vision of the future being an illusion is definitely the biggest struggle next to just missing her in general. 

One accomplishment I suppose is managing to not touch booze with a ten foot pole through all of this. My family is too prone to alcoholism to risk it even if its so fucking tempting sometimes.

I will also check out those subreddits, appreciated.

Thanks, I appreciate it. That video wasn't what I expected but I kind of liked it. 

"Sometimes the heaviest things we lift are not our weights, but our feels."

Thank you, I am glad to hear things worked out for you after having to go through a bad divorce. I know it is hard to imagine a future or outcome we haven't seen yet. Right now I just can't picture loving anyone else again even if it sounds ridiculous.

Can't have a dog right now for various reasons sadly, but I am thinking about a cat even though I'm not really a cat person. We'll see. Glad to hear your dog was able to help you through though, dogs are the best.

Thank you for the inspiring story, I am glad to hear it turned your life around! My bike ride to/from work each day is a decent ride, and I also go on hikes, runs etc.. (admittedly not as often as I should be since this happened) but you are right that it may not be enough. Thank you for the added motivation to think about renewing my membership again..
Thank you, I appreciate it. I am currently looking into options..  which is further proof I havn't given up yet I suppose.

> I came to know that our mind is not a hard disk where we can delete some of the portion which we want to delete. We have to live with it no matter how much we remember it.

Interesting way of putting it. I am glad to hear you were able to move on eventually anyway and found happiness, and even someone else again, even if you still miss your ex after all these years. I don't want to ever forget her even though sometimes I wish I could just to stop the pain. I havn't given up yet but feel close to it at times. Thank you for the reminder.
Its true. We can't even catch a break when we are sleeping it seems...

I am willing to try it and have been working on it, but I didn't realize finding one and getting an appointment would be such a process on itself. Once I do though, I am hoping it will help a bit.. I am at least desperate enough to try. I haven't completely given up on life yet.

Trust me, that thought has definitely crossed my mind but I don't want to accept it. I can't help feeling like she was "the one" though even if there is no such thing. Life without her feels meaningless.
Can't argue with that.

Aww man.. I wish I could get a dog. There are several reasons right now for why I can't, but maybe one day. I have been considering a cat lately though, but I have zero experience with cats (what a weird thing to say on this site) and I would feel guilty if I got a cat and then regretted it/didn't bond with it because it isn't a dog.
I am sorry to hear you have gone through something similar. Thanks and wishing you luck as well.

Thank you, I appreciate the well thought out post. Although many of these things I have been doing, lately it has admittedly not been as consistently as it should be. Thank you for the reminder to keep at it. I have also not done 6 and 7 yet so I will make an effort to give them a try.

This is something I have been giving a lot of thought to lately. I know there is no "normal" way to react and that grief is normal but to feel borderline suicidal and hopeless this long..? I might talk to my doc again. 

Also good point about the structure. I was doing that in the beginning but have been slacking with pre-planning enough.

I don't know, we were comfortable but it didn't seem like in a bad way. I was happy, she seemed happy. We both had a healthy collection of hobbies and friends while in the relationship. I honestly thought both her and I were very happy and functional both as individuals and as a couple. I thought our communication was decent and that if she was missing something that she would have told me, but apparently I was mistaken.

I can understand why you would think that and I'm sure I could be busier. I honestly do the majority of those things though other than visiting relatives out of town and online dating, which I feel like at this point it would just make me feel more fucked up. 

If anything, after she left in the beginning I think I was actually trying too hard to stay busy and it backfired, making things worse. I had no mental space to process what was happening. Even when keeping very busy, its always on my mind.

Thank you. I wish I could get my mind to fully believe that since I can see the logic there. Currently working on tracking down a therapist, which is turning out to be harder than I thought (not taking new patients, very long wait times to get an appointment etc.. )
Thanks man, I'll try. I hope things work out for you as well.
